requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

465-728-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3899-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1669-3147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

465-670-1619-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6138.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from exile to the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5434-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5434-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5434-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

1636-4694-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat
1636-4694-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

140-1745-7433.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1824-4549-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-4549-6709.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

3581-3682-4331.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
3581-3682-4331.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-2208-5921.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1409-1418-1652.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve both Patron of the Arts triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

579-2366-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1995-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.

215-4010-6723-7060.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-7060.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2173-2478-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2173-2478-2854-4574.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3214-4090.description:
Activate Firedrinker Satyr by paying {1}{R}, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah.
Firedrinker Satyr triggers, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, which causes the game to end in a draw.

339-677-1251-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3755-4222-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3976-4406-6852.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3976-4406-6852.description:
Cast Chance for Glory by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Chance for Glory and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Discontinuity and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Chance for Glory and Discontinuity noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Discontinuity without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Chance for Glory trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-3197-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-4476.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1772-3470-3756.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

573-1479-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-6528.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

618-997-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

317-5641.notablePrerequisites: Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
317-5641.description:
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2225-5611.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2225-5611.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate the Insect by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

567-1981-2773.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
567-1981-2773.description:
Cast Soul's Attendant by paying {W}.
When Soul's Attendant enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat from step 3.

2499-3089-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
